exports.full_elaborated_type:
∀ (I : Type u) (X : I → Type v) (T : Type w) [inst : Fintype.{u} I] [Nonempty.{u + 1} I] [(i : I) → Fintype.{v} (X i)]
  [Fintype.{w} T] [inst_4 : DecidableEq.{u + 1} I] [inst_5 : (i : I) → DecidableEq.{v + 1} (X i)]
  [inst_6 : DecidableEq.{w + 1} T] (z : PidMgwBridgeContract.Key.{u, v, w} I X T)
  (alpha : PidMgwBridgeContract.Node.{u} I) (rows : List.{max (max w v) u} (PidMgwBridgeContract.Key.{u, v, w} I X T))
  (hz :
    @Membership.mem.{max (max u v) w, max (max u v) w} (PidMgwBridgeContract.Key.{u, v, w} I X T)
      (List.{max (max w v) u} (PidMgwBridgeContract.Key.{u, v, w} I X T))
      (@List.instMembership.{max (max u v) w} (PidMgwBridgeContract.Key.{u, v, w} I X T)) rows z),
  And
    (@Eq.{1} Real (@PidPrefixProbabilityContract.positiveOnPrefix.{u, v, w} I X T inst inst_4 inst_5 z alpha rows)
      (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero)))
    (@Eq.{1} Real
      (@PidPrefixProbabilityContract.negativeOnPrefix.{u, v, w} I X T inst inst_4 inst_5 inst_6 z alpha rows)
      (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Real (nat_lit 0) (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} Real Real.instZero)))

statements.F1: For every finite nonempty source-index set, finite coordinate/target alphabets, equality instances, normalized nonnegative finite law p, arbitrary event A and natural n: splitting the iid (n+1)-row measure restricted to n misses followed by a hit yields the product of the unnormalized complement-masked n-row law and hit-masked final-row law.
statements.F2: Under the same premises, event mass a lies in [0,1] and the first-hit word has measure ENNReal.ofReal((1-a)^n*a), including n=0 and a=0 or1.
statements.F4: For every declared finite source/target setting, anchor z, node alpha and comparison list containing the complete source-plus-target key z, both native positive and target-filtered negative prefix contributions equal zero. No law or independence premise is used.

semantic_review.F1_F2_printed_type_note: Pretty-printed theorem types name the complete target abbreviations. Root separately read their source expansions and raw propositions; native semantic judges compare full types definitionally and compile exact raw/alias assignments. The printed strings alone are not expanded-statement evidence.
semantic_review.frozen_metadata_note: Source proposal comments and packet.scope planning labels remain immutable pre-execution metadata. This acceptance and actual terminal receipts carry the new runtime disposition; they are not retroactively edited.

statistical_scope: Ideal iid auxiliary rows from a fixed finite law; if the law is a fitted table, the result is conditional on that frozen table. No inference of iid raw sensor rows or population calibration. F4 is deterministic.
novelty: F1/F2 are classical finite probability formalized in the project framework; F4 is an invariant of the project prefix definition, rechecked here. No scientific-priority or breakthrough claim.
projection_limits: Original private records remain unchanged. Public metadata omits declared process/session/terminal handles and replaces complete private roots with role placeholders. Original-native hashes are not hashes of the projected files. Of 58 selected main streams, 56 preserve native bytes and two PRE/POST boundary stdout files retain the already declared v1 locator projections. All 41 theorem/control values are unchanged. This supplies no new native, portable, hosted, atomicity or binary-authentication credit.
